tools.name: academy_dailyrecord_get
tools.title: Read live DailyRecord by student name (today by default)
tools.description:
Read live DailyRecord by exact student name. Preferred for requests such as “오늘 학생 DailyRecord 조회해봐” or current/today DailyRecord lookups. Omit lessonDate for today in Asia/Seoul. The owner launch supplies namespace, teacher and admitted dates; this tool resolves the name to a native key then calls academy_dailyrecord_intake. Never use saved academy_query or academy_source_status to decide live availability. Ambiguous names, missing admission, out-of-range dates or failed source reads stop with a named blocker; no guesses or automatic retry. Returns observed fields even when authoring would require a memo/assessment interview. No authoring, save or send.

Academy routing context: 오늘/지난 수업일의 DailyRecord·수업일지 진도, 숙제, 메모 조회. Backend/source: DayRecordServlet; p_process=Main; academy.lms.dayrecord. Preferred exact-name read for current AND historical lesson dates. A historical lesson date does not select a saved snapshot. Authoring interviews do not make an observed read unavailable.
End Academy routing context.
